title: Traffic takes unexpected path — local-preference override misroutes flows
symptom: Traffic to CustA prefix 10.1.0.0/24 is routing through R1 (10.255.0.1, the route reflector) instead of the direct R2→R3 path. Both paths are Established and available. BGP shows the same prefix with two next-hops but R1 is selected as the best path.

inject.note: An inbound route-map on the iBGP session to R1 (RR) sets local-pref to 50 for all received routes. Routes received directly from R3 (eBGP, default local-pref 100) are now preferred over the RR path, but the SET-LOW-LOCPREF is applied to the wrong session — it should be on the eBGP session to reduce the eBGP-learned prefix, not on the iBGP session.

ground_truth.root_cause: inbound route-map SET-LOW-LOCPREF on iBGP session to R1 (10.255.0.1) reduces local-preference to 50 — routes via RR appear worse than direct eBGP path (local-pref 100); intended policy was applied to the wrong session
ground_truth.fix: Remove route-map from iBGP session: no neighbor 10.255.0.1 route-map SET-LOW-LOCPREF in
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp 10.1.0.0/24 shows correct best-path selection with local-pref 100 via the intended path
